# freeBSD has the editor ee

pkg update
pkg install postgresql16-server postgresql16-client nats-server prometheus grafana10 haproxy prometheus-nats-exporter

pkg install zig git zstd

# ZeBridge
touch /var/log/zebridge_fast.log
touch /var/log/zebridge_large.log
chown nobody:nobody /var/log/zebridge_fast.log
chown nobody:nobody /var/log/zebridge_large.log




# NATS-exporter
# Configure nats-exporter arguments directly in rc.conf
sysrc prometheus_nats_exporter_args="-varz -jsz=all http://localhost:8222"

# Prometheus
sysrc prometheus_ev="GOMEMLIMIT=750MiB"
sysrc prometheus_args="--storage.tsdb.retention.time=1d --storage.tsdb.min-block-duration=2h --storage.tsdb.max-block-duration=2h"
chown prometheus:prometheus /usr/local/etc/prometheus.yml
# check Prometheus conf
promtool check config /usr/local/etc/prometheus.yml

# HAProxy
# check HAProxy conf
haproxy -c -f /usr/local/etc/haproxy.conf

# Packet filter (firewall rules)
sysrc pf_enable="YES"
sysrc pf_rules="/etc/pf.conf"
sysrc pflog_enable="YES" # Optional: enables logging of blocked packets
# check pf
pfctl -n -f /etc/pf.conf

# Enable services
sysrc postgresql_enable="YES"
sysrc nats_enable="YES"
sysrc prometheus_enable="YES"
sysrc grafana_enable="YES"
sysrc haproxy_enable="YES"
sysrc prometheus_nats_exporter_enable="YES"

# start
service pf start
service postgresql initdb # Only run this once to create the PG data directory!
service postgresql start
service nats start
service prometheus start
service grafana start
service haproxy start
service prometheus_nats_exporter start

# install ZeBridge
# Create a dedicated directory for your custom daemons
mkdir -p /opt/zebridge
cd /opt/zebridge

# Clone your repository
git clone https://github.com/your-username/zebridge.git .

# Build for the native architecture with release optimizations
zig build -Doptimize=ReleaseFast
